title: 第9章 降服第10章 凝聚灵宝
content_zh:
蛟龙来到平时生活的水潭边想都没想一头扎了进去，杨修追到水潭边犯了难，这水潭不浅他如果潜进去肯定会实力受限很多，杨修站在潭边陷入了思索，而身后郑元雪气喘吁吁的也追了上他。
“呼～蛟龙呢？”郑元雪因为跑的太快大口喘息着。
杨修没说话指了指水潭。
郑元雪看到杨修皱眉，深呼吸一下，平复一下紊乱的气息道“没办法了吧！这时候该我出马了！”
只见郑元雪从储物戒中掏出一枚丹药丢入水中，随后又拿出一枚像是香囊一样的东西开口道“你凑过来一点！”
杨修疑惑着走了过去开口“那枚丹药是什么？”
“那枚丹药具体叫什么名字我不知道，但是我知道它溶于水会散发出剧烈的臭味，”郑元雪开口解释，随后挥了挥类似于香囊一样的东西道，“这个呢！属于一种小法器唯一的用处就是让周围空气清新，我在皇宫内做过实验，这个完全可以屏蔽掉那丹药的臭味！”
杨修右手举出伸出一个拇指说道“不愧是皇室中人，什么稀奇玩意儿都有。”
咕嘟咕嘟正在两人对话的时候水潭中传来波动，两人目光聚齐过去，不一会儿“哗”的一声，蛟龙从潭底冲了出来，虽说妖兽的表情很难分辨，但是蛟龙扭曲的面孔可以看出它受到的折磨并不轻。
“这就出来了，我以为你还能再坚持一下呢！”郑元雪语气失望的说道，然后随手从储物戒又掏出一枚丹药扔进水里，拉着杨修后背的衣服示意让他等一下，大约过了一分钟她松开杨修将小法器收了起来。
蛟龙一动不动的趴伏在地，呆滞的眼神不知道的人还以为它死了呢，杨修走过去用剑柄戳了戳它，这时候蛟龙才开始缓慢抬起头来，它甩了甩头，眼神逐渐清澈起来。
“人类，你们想干什么？”蛟龙并未开口但是声音却传入杨修和郑元雪的耳中。
杨修还没开口郑元雪边惊讶道“你居然能口吐人言？”
“很奇怪吗？”蛟龙又道。
“你的境界还没有到入道境吧，怎么能口吐人言呢？”郑元雪问道。
“小娃娃懂什么？我可是拥有一丝真龙血脉的，要做到简单的传音入耳还是很简单的。”蛟龙语气中带着得意的说道。
“呦！真龙血脉为什么被小小的人类打败了呢？”郑元雪听到蛟龙口中的骄傲，心里生出了一种戏弄它的心思开口道。
蛟龙听出了郑元雪语气当中的调笑意味，虽然愤怒但没办法出手让他不得不压下火气没好气的说“哼！要不是我刚蜕变身体虚弱，这小小的人族剑修又怎能伤得了我？”
谁知蛟龙的反应让郑元雪内心的那种恶趣味更浓开口“喔喔喔！原来是这样啊？你打扰了我们两人吃晚饭，我想想要怎么惩罚你呢？”
郑元雪假装思索其实她早就想好了，看着杨修笑着说道“要不我们把它吃掉吧，听说蛟龙肉大补！”

杨修看着郑元雪的表情知道她在逗弄蛟龙一脸无奈的看着她“内心压抑太久了吧！”杨修心里这样想但是并未开口。
蛟龙听到这个原本不服的情绪变成了惊慌赶忙开口道“不要吃我！我的肉又老又柴一点都不好吃，如果你们真的饿的话我可以帮你们去狩猎野兽给你们吃。”
郑元雪目光转回蛟龙身上一脸无邪的看着蛟龙说道“开始我们就是想尝尝蛟龙肉，怎么办呀？”
蛟龙听着这个一脸无邪的女人类说出的话，让它脊背一凉，心中生出惊恐。
杨修不想让郑元雪继续逗弄蛟龙怕真把蛟龙惹怒闹个鱼死网破便开口道“好了！别逗它了。”
content_en:
Jiaolong came to the pool where he usually lived and dived in without thinking. Yang Xiu chased him to the pool and ran into trouble. The pool was not shallow and if he dived in, his strength would be greatly restricted. Yang Xiu stood by the pool and fell into thinking, while Zheng Yuanxue caught up with him behind him, panting.
"Huh~ Where's the dragon?" Zheng Yuanxue gasped because she was running too fast.
Yang Xiu pointed to the pool without saying anything.
Zheng Yuanxue saw Yang Xiu frowning, took a deep breath, calmed down the disordered breath and said, "There is nothing we can do! It's time for me to take action!"
Zheng Yuanxue took out an elixir from the storage ring and threw it into the water. Then he took out something like a sachet and said, "Come closer!"
Yang Xiu walked over in confusion and asked, "What is that pill?"
"I don't know the specific name of that elixir, but I know that it will emit a strong odor when dissolved in water," Zheng Yuanxue explained, then waved something similar to a sachet and said, "Here's this! It is a small magic weapon whose only purpose is to freshen the surrounding air. I have done experiments in the palace, and this can completely block the odor of the elixir!"
Yang Xiu raised his right hand and extended a thumb and said, "As expected of a member of the royal family, he has all kinds of rare things."
While Gudu Gudu was having a conversation with each other, there was a wave in the pool. The two of them focused their gazes on it. After a while, there was a "crash" sound, and the dragon rushed out from the bottom of the pool. Although it was difficult to distinguish the expression of the monster, the twisted face of the dragon showed that it was not lightly tortured.
"It's here, I thought you could hold on a little longer!" Zheng Yuanxue said in a disappointed tone, then casually took out another pill from the storage ring and threw it into the water. She pulled the clothes on Yang Xiu's back to signal him to wait. After about a minute, she let go of Yang Xiu and put away the small magic weapon.
The dragon lay motionless on the ground, with dull eyes. People who didn't know it thought it was dead. Yang Xiu walked over and poked it with the hilt of his sword. At this time, the dragon began to slowly raise its head. It shook its head, and its eyes gradually became clear.
"Humans, what do you want to do?" Jiaolong did not speak but his voice reached the ears of Yang Xiu and Zheng Yuanxue.
Before Yang Xiu opened his mouth, Zheng Yuanxue said in surprise, "You can actually speak human words?"
"Is it weird?" Jiaolong asked again.
"You haven't reached the Taoist realm yet, how can you speak human words?" Zheng Yuanxue asked.
"What do you know, little kid? I have a trace of true dragon blood. It's very simple to transmit sound to my ears." Jiaolong said with a proud tone.
"Hey! Why was the true dragon bloodline defeated by a little human?" Zheng Yuanxue heard the pride in Jiaolong's mouth, and she had a desire to tease it and said.
Jiaolong heard the teasing tone in Zheng Yuanxue's tone. Although he was angry, he couldn't take action. He had to suppress his anger and said angrily, "Humph! If I hadn't just transformed into a weak body, how could this little human swordsman hurt me?"
Unexpectedly, Jiaolong's reaction made Zheng Yuanxue's bad taste even stronger and said, "Oh, oh, oh! So that's it? You disturbed our dinner, how should I punish you?"
Zheng Yuanxue pretended to think about it, but she had already thought about it. She looked at Yang Xiu and said with a smile, "How about we eat it? I heard that dragon meat is very nourishing!"
Yang Xiu looked at Zheng Yuanxue's expression and knew that she was teasing Jiaolong. He looked at her helplessly, "You must have been depressed for too long!" Yang Xiu thought in his heart but did not speak.
When Jiaolong heard this, his originally dissatisfied mood turned into panic and he hurriedly said, "Don't eat me! My meat is old and woody and doesn't taste good at all. If you are really hungry, I can help you hunt wild beasts for you to eat."
Zheng Yuanxue turned her eyes back to Jiaolong and looked at Jiaolong with an innocent face and said, "We just wanted to taste Jiaolong meat in the first place. What should we do?"
Jiaolong listensThe words spoken by this innocent-looking female human sent a shiver down its spine and panic in its heart.
Yang Xiu didn't want Zheng Yuanxue to continue teasing the dragon, so he said, "Okay! Stop teasing it."
